import pLimit from "p-limit";
import { z } from "zod";
import { gw } from "../gateway";
import { agencyNames, getDoc, getRawText, listWindow } from "../fr";
import { profileBrief } from "../profiles";
import { assignTier } from "../tier";
import type { ActionItem, CompanyProfile, Deadline, FilterDecision, FrDoc } from "../types";
import { parseDocNumberFromUrl, verifyQuotedDate } from "../verify";
import type { RunCtx } from "./context";

// ───────────────────────────── Scan ─────────────────────────────

export async function scan(ctx: RunCtx): Promise<FrDoc[]> {
  const { windowStart, windowEnd } = ctx.run.config;
  return ctx.stage("scan:federal-register", () => listWindow(windowStart, windowEnd), (r) => ({ outCount: r.length }));
}

/**
 * Web leads: a bounded tool loop with Exa. Every URL must resolve to a Federal Register
 * document number; anything that doesn't is dropped (no silent supplement from the web).
 */
export async function webLeads(ctx: RunCtx, profile: CompanyProfile, docs: FrDoc[]) {
  const { windowStart, windowEnd, model } = ctx.run.config;
  const inWindow = new Set(docs.map((d) => d.document_number));
  return ctx.stage(
    "scan:web-leads",
    async () => {
      const r = await ctx.agent("web-leads", {
        model,
        maxSteps: 4,
        tools: {
          exa_search: gw.tools.exaSearch({
            numResults: 8,
            startPublishedDate: `${windowStart}T00:00:00Z`,
            endPublishedDate: `${windowEnd}T23:59:59Z`,
            contents: { highlights: { maxCharacters: 300 } },
          }),
        },
        system: "You find leads on new US federal regulatory actions. Search, then list the URLs you found. Do not summarise law from memory.",
        prompt: `${profileBrief(profile)}\n\nFind US federal regulatory developments (final rules, proposed rules, guidance, enforcement) published ${windowStart} to ${windowEnd} that could affect this company. Run at most 3 searches. Reply with the URLs only.`,
      });
      const urls = new Set<string>();
      for (const c of r.toolCalls) {
        const results = (c.output as { results?: { url?: string }[] } | undefined)?.results ?? [];
        results.forEach((x) => x.url && urls.add(x.url));
      }
      r.sources?.forEach((s) => "url" in s && s.url && urls.add(s.url));
      return [...urls].map((url) => {
        const n = parseDocNumberFromUrl(url);
        return { url, document_number: n, inWindow: !!n && inWindow.has(n) };
      });
    },
    (r) => ({ outCount: r.length, note: `${r.filter((x) => x.document_number).length} resolved to FR, ${r.filter((x) => x.inWindow).length} already in scan` }),
  );
}

// ───────────────────────────── Filter ─────────────────────────────

const docBlock = (d: FrDoc) =>
  [`[${d.document_number}] ${d.type} — ${agencyNames(d).join("; ")}`, `Title: ${d.title}`, d.action ? `Action: ${d.action}` : "", `Abstract: ${(d.abstract ?? "(none)").slice(0, 1200)}`]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n");

const JEV_QUESTION =
  "Would the general counsel of this company need to know about this federal document because it could create, change or remove a compliance obligation or material legal risk for the company's actual business lines? Routine filings for other industries are not relevant.";

export async function filterJev(ctx: RunCtx, profile: CompanyProfile, docs: FrDoc[]) {
  const brief = profileBrief(profile);
  const limit = pLimit(16);
  return ctx.stage(
    "filter:jev",
    async () => {
      const out = new Map<string, number>();
      await Promise.all(
        docs.map((d) =>
          limit(async () => {
            const r = await ctx.jev(`${brief}\n\n--- DOCUMENT ---\n${docBlock(d)}`, JEV_QUESTION);
            out.set(d.document_number, r.p);
          }),
        ),
      );
      return out;
    },
    (m) => ({ inCount: docs.length, outCount: [...m.values()].filter((p) => p >= ctx.run.config.jevThreshold).length, note: `threshold ${ctx.run.config.jevThreshold}` }),
  );
}

export async function filterLlm(ctx: RunCtx, profile: CompanyProfile, docs: FrDoc[]) {
  const areaKeys = Object.keys(profile.areas) as [string, ...string[]];
  const schema = z.object({
    decisions: z.array(
      z.object({
        document_number: z.string(),
        relevant: z.boolean(),
        reason: z.string().describe("One line, specific to this company. Name the business line affected or why not."),
        areas: z.array(z.enum(areaKeys)).describe("Affected areas; empty if not relevant"),
      }),
    ),
  });
  const system = `You are an in-house regulatory analyst triaging the Federal Register for one company. Be precise: mark relevant only if the document could create, change or remove an obligation or material legal risk for the company's actual business lines. Return exactly one decision per document number given — no more, no fewer.\n\nAffected areas:\n${Object.entries(profile.areas)
    .map(([k, v]) => `- ${k}: ${v.description}`)
    .join("\n")}`;
  const BATCH = 20;
  const batches: FrDoc[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH) batches.push(docs.slice(i, i + BATCH));
  const limit = pLimit(4);

  return ctx.stage(
    "filter:llm",
    async () => {
      const out = new Map<string, { relevant: boolean; reason: string; areas: string[] }>();
      await Promise.all(
        batches.map((batch, bi) =>
          limit(async () => {
            let pending = batch;
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2 && pending.length; attempt++) {
              const r = await ctx.object(`filter-llm#${bi}${attempt ? "-retry" : ""}`, {
                model: ctx.run.config.model,
                system,
                prompt: `${profileBrief(profile)}\n\n=== DOCUMENTS (${pending.length}) ===\n\n${pending.map(docBlock).join("\n\n")}`,
                schema,
              });
              const want = new Set(pending.map((d) => d.document_number));
              for (const dec of r.decisions) if (want.has(dec.document_number)) out.set(dec.document_number, dec);
              // Contract check: the model must answer for every input document. Missing ones are retried once.
              pending = pending.filter((d) => !out.has(d.document_number));
            }
          }),
        ),
      );
      return out;
    },
    (m) => ({ inCount: docs.length, outCount: [...m.values()].filter((x) => x.relevant).length, note: `${docs.length - m.size} unanswered after retry` }),
  );
}

// ───────────────────────────── Verify + Tier (code) ─────────────────────────────

const extractSchema = z.object({
  deadlines: z.array(
    z.object({
      date: z.string().describe("YYYY-MM-DD"),
      kind: z.enum(["comment", "effective", "compliance", "other"]),
      quote: z.string().describe("Exact verbatim sentence from the text that states this date. Copy, do not paraphrase."),
    }),
  ),
});

export async function verifyAndTier(ctx: RunCtx, profile: CompanyProfile, docs: FrDoc[], decisions: Map<string, FilterDecision>) {
  const limit = pLimit(6);
  const dropped: { document_number: string; why: string }[] = [];
  const items = await ctx.stage(
    "verify+tier",
    async () => {
      const res = await Promise.all(
        docs.map((scanned) =>
          limit(async (): Promise<ActionItem | null> => {
            // 1. Re-fetch from the primary source.
            const doc = await getDoc(scanned.document_number);
            if (!doc) {
              dropped.push({ document_number: scanned.document_number, why: "re-fetch failed: not found on federalregister.gov" });
              return null;
            }
            const deadlines: Deadline[] = [];
            const fieldCheck = (date: string | null, scannedDate: string | null, kind: Deadline["kind"]) => {
              if (!date && !scannedDate) return;
              const ok = !!date && date === scannedDate;
              deadlines.push({ date: (date ?? scannedDate)!, kind, source: "fr_field", verified: ok, verifyNote: ok ? "matches FR API field on re-fetch" : `scan said ${scannedDate}, re-fetch says ${date}` });
            };
            fieldCheck(doc.comments_close_on, scanned.comments_close_on, "comment");
            fieldCheck(doc.effective_on, scanned.effective_on, "effective");

            // 2. Dates that only live in prose (compliance dates, missing fields): model extracts with a quote, code verifies the quote.
            const raw = await getRawText(doc);
            const source = `${doc.dates ?? ""}\n${raw}`;
            const snippet = `${doc.dates ?? ""}\n\n${raw.slice(0, 7000)}`;
            if (snippet.trim().length > 20) {
              const ex = await ctx.object(`extract-dates:${doc.document_number}`, {
                model: ctx.run.config.model,
                system: "Extract every dated obligation or deadline (comment due, effective, compliance) stated in the text. Quote the sentence verbatim. If none, return an empty list.",
                prompt: `Document ${doc.document_number}: ${doc.title}\n\n${snippet}`,
                schema: extractSchema,
                logPrompt: false,
              });
              for (const e of ex.deadlines) {
                if (deadlines.some((d) => d.date === e.date && d.kind === e.kind)) continue;
                const v = verifyQuotedDate(source, e.quote, e.date);
                deadlines.push({ date: e.date, kind: e.kind, source: "extracted", quote: e.quote, verified: v.ok, verifyNote: v.ok ? "quote found verbatim in primary source" : v.why });
              }
            }

            // 3. Tier: pure code.
            const t = assignTier({ type: doc.type, deadlines, asOf: ctx.run.config.asOf });
            const dec = decisions.get(doc.document_number);
            const areas = dec?.llm?.areas ?? [];
            const owner = areas.length ? profile.areas[areas[0]]?.owner ?? profile.generalCounsel : profile.generalCounsel;
            return {
              document_number: doc.document_number,
              title: doc.title,
              type: doc.type,
              agencies: agencyNames(doc),
              tier: t.tier,
              tierReason: t.reason,
              deadline: t.deadline,
              deadlines,
              owner,
              areas,
              reason: dec?.llm?.reason ?? (dec?.jevProbability !== undefined ? `Jev p=${dec.jevProbability.toFixed(2)} (no LLM reason)` : ""),
              action: "",
              citation: doc.citation,
              citationVerified: !!doc.citation && doc.citation === scanned.citation,
              url: doc.html_url,
              sourceTag: "[Federal Register]",
            };
          }),
        ),
      );
      return res.filter((x): x is ActionItem => !!x);
    },
    (r) => ({ inCount: docs.length, outCount: r.length, note: `${r.reduce((a, i) => a + i.deadlines.filter((d) => !d.verified).length, 0)} unverified dates dropped from tiering` }),
  );
  return { items, dropped };
}

// ───────────────────────────── Output ─────────────────────────────

const TIER_ORDER = { Critical: 0, High: 1, Medium: 2, Low: 3 } as const;

export async function writeActions(ctx: RunCtx, profile: CompanyProfile, items: ActionItem[]) {
  if (!items.length) return items;
  const schema = z.object({ actions: z.array(z.object({ document_number: z.string(), action: z.string() })) });
  return ctx.stage(
    "output:actions",
    async () => {
      const r = await ctx.object("output-actions", {
        model: ctx.run.config.model,
        system:
          "Write one action item per document for a busy general counsel: an imperative sentence (≤ 25 words) saying what the owner should do and why, in plain English a non-lawyer understands — spell out acronyms, no regulatory jargon. Do NOT write any dates or citations — those are rendered separately from verified data.",
        prompt: `${profileBrief(profile)}\n\n${items
          .map((i) => `[${i.document_number}] ${i.type}: ${i.title}\nTier: ${i.tier} (${i.tierReason})\nOwner: ${i.owner.name}\nWhy relevant: ${i.reason}`)
          .join("\n\n")}`,
        schema,
      });
      const byNum = new Map(r.actions.map((a) => [a.document_number, a.action]));
      // Guardrail: the LLM text must not smuggle in dates. Strip any that slipped through.
      const DATE_RE = /\b(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.? \d{1,2}, \d{4}\b|\b\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{4}\b|\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b/g;
      return items
        .map((i) => ({ ...i, action: (byNum.get(i.document_number) ?? "Review.").replace(DATE_RE, "[date — see deadline]") }))
        .sort((a, b) => TIER_ORDER[a.tier] - TIER_ORDER[b.tier] || (a.deadline?.date ?? "9").localeCompare(b.deadline?.date ?? "9"));
    },
    (r) => ({ outCount: r.length }),
  );
}

export function renderMarkdown(profile: CompanyProfile, cfg: { windowStart: string; windowEnd: string; asOf: string }, items: ActionItem[]) {
  const lines = [`# Regulatory triage — ${profile.name}`, `Window ${cfg.windowStart} → ${cfg.windowEnd} · as of ${cfg.asOf} · ${items.length} items`, ""];
  for (const tier of ["Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low"] as const) {
    const group = items.filter((i) => i.tier === tier);
    if (!group.length) continue;
    lines.push(`## ${tier} (${group.length})`, "");
    for (const i of group) {
      lines.push(
        `- **${i.title}** ${i.sourceTag}`,
        `  - ${i.action}`,
        `  - Deadline: ${i.deadline ? `${i.deadline.date} (${i.deadline.kind}, ${i.deadline.source === "fr_field" ? "FR field" : "quoted"} ✓)` : "none found"} · Owner: ${i.owner.name} · Areas: ${i.areas.join(", ") || "—"}`,
        `  - ${i.citation ?? i.document_number}${i.citationVerified ? " ✓" : " (unverified)"} · ${i.url}`,
      );
    }
    lines.push("");
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}
import { differenceInCalendarDays, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import type { Deadline, DocType, Tier } from "./types";

export const CRITICAL_WINDOW_DAYS = 90;
/** A final rule that took effect this recently is still an active fire drill. Older = catch-up publication. */
export const RECENTLY_EFFECTIVE_DAYS = 30;

/**
 * Deterministic tiering. No model involved: same inputs → same tier, every run.
 *
 * Rules (RFC: "deadline < 90 days = Critical", sharpened by claude-for-legal's doc-type tiers):
 *  - Only verified deadlines count.
 *  - Rule / Proposed Rule with an upcoming deadline 0..89 days from `asOf` → Critical.
 *  - Final Rule that took effect within the last 30 days → Critical ("already in effect").
 *    Older effective dates (e.g. OFAC licenses published months after issuance) → High.
 *  - Notice with an upcoming deadline → Medium (PRA comment requests etc. are not emergencies).
 *  - Otherwise by type: Rule → High, Proposed Rule → Medium, Notice/Presidential → Low.
 */
export function assignTier(input: {
  type: DocType;
  deadlines: Deadline[];
  asOf: string;
}): { tier: Tier; deadline: Deadline | null; reason: string } {
  const asOf = parseISO(input.asOf);
  const verified = input.deadlines.filter((d) => d.verified);
  const days = (d: Deadline) => differenceInCalendarDays(parseISO(d.date), asOf);

  const upcoming = verified
    .filter((d) => days(d) >= 0)
    .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  const next = upcoming[0] ?? null;
  const isRulemaking = input.type === "Rule" || input.type === "Proposed Rule";

  if (next && isRulemaking && days(next) < CRITICAL_WINDOW_DAYS) {
    return { tier: "Critical", deadline: next, reason: `${next.kind} deadline in ${days(next)} days (< ${CRITICAL_WINDOW_DAYS})` };
  }

  const pastEffective = verified
    .filter((d) => d.kind === "effective" && days(d) < 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))[0];

/**
 * Experiment 2 — what our evals look like.
 *
 * Following Anthropic's "Demystifying evals for AI agents":
 *  - grade the OUTCOME with code where possible (recall/precision on FR document numbers,
 *    dates checked against the primary source),
 *  - grade the TRANSCRIPT as a secondary signal (did it ground on federalregister.gov?),
 *  - use an LLM judge only where code can't (is the action item usable?).
 *
 * EVAL_MODE=replay  → grade the latest saved run per case (free, regression-style).
 * EVAL_MODE=live    → execute fresh runs (spends money; capability-style). Default: replay.
 */
import { generateText, Output } from "ai";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { createHarness, createJudge, describeEval } from "vitest-evals";
import { z } from "zod";
import { gw } from "../src/lib/gateway";
import { execute, newRun } from "../src/lib/pipeline/run";
import { scoreRun } from "../src/lib/score";
import { listRuns, loadLabels } from "../src/lib/store";
import type { RunConfig, RunRecord } from "../src/lib/types";

const WINDOW = { profileId: "ledgerly", windowStart: "2026-11-09", windowEnd: "2026-11-13", asOf: "2026-11-13" };
const MODEL = process.env.EVAL_MODEL ?? "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5";
const LIVE = process.env.EVAL_MODE === "live";

type CaseInput = { name: string; config: RunConfig };
type CaseOutput = {
  runId: string;
  recall: number;
  precision: number;
  tp: number;
  fp: number;
  fn: number;
  missed: string[];
  extra: string[];
  datesShown: number;
  datesVerified: number;
  unresolved: number;
  costUsd: number;
  seconds: number;
  items: { document_number: string; tier: string; owner: string; action: string; reason: string; sourceTag: string }[];
  groundedOnFR: boolean;
};

const CASES: CaseInput[] = [
  { name: "pipeline · jev@0.1 → llm", config: { ...WINDOW, mode: "pipeline", model: MODEL, filter: "jev+llm", jevThreshold: 0.1, webLeads: false } },
  { name: "pipeline · llm on every doc", config: { ...WINDOW, mode: "pipeline", model: MODEL, filter: "llm", jevThreshold: 0, webLeads: false } },
  { name: "baseline · one prompt + native search", config: { ...WINDOW, mode: "baseline", model: MODEL, filter: "llm", jevThreshold: 0, webLeads: false } },
];

const sameCfg = (a: RunConfig, b: RunConfig) =>
  a.mode === b.mode && a.model === b.model && a.windowStart === b.windowStart && a.windowEnd === b.windowEnd &&
  (a.mode === "baseline" || (a.filter === b.filter && (a.filter === "llm" || a.jevThreshold === b.jevThreshold)));

async function getRun(cfg: RunConfig): Promise<RunRecord | null> {
  if (LIVE) return execute(newRun(cfg));
  return (await listRuns()).find((r) => r.status === "done" && sameCfg(r.config, cfg)) ?? null;
}

// CLI: npx tsx scripts/run.mts --mode pipeline --filter jev+llm --runs 1
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { execute, newRun } from "../src/lib/pipeline/run";
import type { RunConfig } from "../src/lib/types";

const { values: a } = parseArgs({
  options: {
    mode: { type: "string", default: "pipeline" },
    profile: { type: "string", default: "ledgerly" },
    start: { type: "string", default: "2026-11-09" },
    end: { type: "string", default: "2026-11-13" },
    asOf: { type: "string" },
    model: { type: "string", default: "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5" },
    filter: { type: "string", default: "jev+llm" },
    threshold: { type: "string", default: "0.3" },
    webLeads: { type: "boolean", default: false },
    runs: { type: "string", default: "1" },
    group: { type: "string" },
  },
});

for (let i = 0; i < Number(a.runs); i++) {
  const cfg: RunConfig = {
    mode: a.mode as RunConfig["mode"],
    profileId: a.profile!,
    windowStart: a.start!,
    windowEnd: a.end!,
    asOf: a.asOf ?? a.end!,
    model: a.model!,
    filter: a.filter as RunConfig["filter"],
    jevThreshold: Number(a.threshold),
    webLeads: a.webLeads!,
    group: a.group,
  };
  const r = await execute(newRun(cfg));
  console.log(`${r.id} ${r.status} ${r.error ?? ""} items=${r.items?.length ?? 0} cost=$${r.totalCostUsd.toFixed(4)} ms=${r.totalMs}`);
  for (const s of r.stages) console.log(`  ${s.name.padEnd(26)} ${String(s.ms).padStart(7)}ms $${s.costUsd.toFixed(4)} in=${s.inCount ?? "-"} out=${s.outCount ?? "-"} ${s.note ?? ""}`);
}

const harness = createHarness<CaseInput, CaseOutput>({
  name: "reg-monitor",
  run: async ({ input }) => {
    const labels = await loadLabels(WINDOW.profileId, WINDOW.windowStart, WINDOW.windowEnd);
    if (!labels?.relevant.length) throw new Error("No labels — label the week at /label first.");
    const run = await getRun(input.config);
    if (!run) throw new Error(`No saved run for "${input.name}" — run it from the UI or set EVAL_MODE=live.`);
    const s = scoreRun(run, labels);
    const items = (run.items ?? []).map((i) => ({ document_number: i.document_number, tier: i.tier, owner: i.owner.name, action: i.action, reason: i.reason, sourceTag: i.sourceTag }));
    // Transcript check: pipeline grounds on the FR API by construction; baseline must have searched AND every kept item resolved to FR.
    const searched = run.calls.some((c) => c.toolCalls?.some((t) => /search/i.test(t.name))) || run.config.mode === "pipeline";
    const output: CaseOutput = {
      runId: run.id,
      recall: s.recall,
      precision: s.precision,
      tp: s.tp,
      fp: s.fp,
      fn: s.fn,
      missed: s.missed,
      extra: s.extra,
      datesShown: s.datesShown,
      datesVerified: s.datesVerified,
      unresolved: s.unresolved,
      costUsd: run.totalCostUsd,
      seconds: run.totalMs / 1000,
      items,
      groundedOnFR: searched && run.stages.some((st) => st.name.startsWith("scan:federal-register") || st.name.includes("resolve")),
    };
    return {
      events: [
        { type: "message", role: "user", content: `${input.name} (${run.id})` },
        ...run.calls.flatMap((c, k) => [
          ...(c.toolCalls ?? []).map((t, j) => ({ type: "tool_call" as const, id: `${k}-${j}`, name: t.name, arguments: (t.input ?? {}) as Record<string, never> })),
        ]),
        { type: "message", role: "assistant", content: run.markdown ?? "" },
      ],
      output,
      usage: {},
    };
  },
});

// ── Code graders ──
const RecallJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Recall ≥ 0.9", ({ output }) => ({ score: output.recall, metadata: { rationale: `tp ${output.tp} / fn ${output.fn}; missed ${output.missed.join(", ") || "none"}` } }));
const PrecisionJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Precision ≥ 0.8", ({ output }) => ({ score: output.precision, metadata: { rationale: `tp ${output.tp} / fp ${output.fp}; extra ${output.extra.join(", ") || "none"}` } }));
const DatesJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Dates verified = 100%", ({ output }) => ({
  score: output.datesShown ? output.datesVerified / output.datesShown : 1,
  metadata: { rationale: `${output.datesVerified}/${output.datesShown} shown deadlines match the Federal Register record` },
}));

// ── Model grader (only where code can't): is each action item forwardable? ──
const ActionQualityJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Action items usable (LLM judge)", async ({ output }) => {
  if (!output.items.length) return { score: 0, metadata: { rationale: "no items" } };
  const r = await generateText({
    model: gw("anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5"),
    output: Output.object({ schema: z.object({ scores: z.array(z.object({ document_number: z.string(), score: z.number().min(0).max(1), why: z.string() })) }) }),
    prompt: `You grade action items a GC would forward to an owner. Score each 0..1: 1 = names a concrete next step, the owner is plausible for the topic, and the reason is specific to the company; 0.5 = vague but not wrong; 0 = wrong owner, generic, or asserts facts not supported by the reason.\n\n${JSON.stringify(output.items, null, 1)}`,
  });
  const scores = r.output.scores;
  const mean = scores.reduce((a, s) => a + s.score, 0) / (scores.length || 1);
  return { score: mean, metadata: { rationale: scores.map((s) => `${s.document_number}: ${s.score} ${s.why}`).join(" | ") } };
});

describeEval(
  "regulatory triage · ledgerly · week of 2026-11-09",
  { harness, judges: [RecallJudge, PrecisionJudge, DatesJudge, ActionQualityJudge], judgeThreshold: null },
  (it) => {
    it.for(CASES)("$name", async (c, { run }) => {
      const result = await run(c);
      const o = result.output;
      console.log(`${c.name}: recall ${o.recall.toFixed(2)} precision ${o.precision.toFixed(2)} dates ${o.datesVerified}/${o.datesShown} unresolved ${o.unresolved} $${o.costUsd.toFixed(3)} ${o.seconds.toFixed(0)}s`);
      // Hard gates from the RFC. Expected to FAIL for the baseline — that's the comparison.
      expect.soft(o.recall, "recall").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.9);
      expect.soft(o.precision, "precision").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.8);
      expect.soft(o.datesVerified, "every shown date verified").toBe(o.datesShown);
      expect.soft(o.groundedOnFR, "grounded on federalregister.gov").toBe(true);
    });
  },
);

}

// One-off: generate config/ from the TS constants that used to hold it (so nothing is retyped).
import fs from "node:fs";
import YAML from "yaml";
import { PROFILES } from "../../src/lib/profiles";
import { ARENA_MODELS } from "../../src/lib/models";
import { METHODS, JEV_THRESHOLD } from "../../src/lib/arena";

import { CRITICAL_WINDOW_DAYS, RECENTLY_EFFECTIVE_DAYS } from "../../src/lib/tier";
import { JUDGE_MODEL } from "../../src/lib/judge";

const w = (p: string, header: string, obj: unknown) => {
  fs.mkdirSync(p.split("/").slice(0, -1).join("/"), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(p, `${header.trim().split("\n").map((l) => `# ${l}`).join("\n")}\n\n${YAML.stringify(obj, { lineWidth: 0, blockQuote: "literal" })}`);
};

for (const p of PROFILES) w(`config/companies/${p.id}.yaml`, `Company profile "${p.id}". Relevance anchor for every prompt; each area routes to exactly one owner.`, p);

w("config/setups.yaml", `Arena setups = models x methods. Each ticked (model, method) pair is one config the code executes.
Models: one flagship per vendor at price parity ($2 in / $10 out per M tokens on the Gateway, checked 2026-11-21).
search = which web search the baseline gets (vendor-native where it exists, otherwise the Gateway's Exa).
estUsd = rough $/run for the pre-flight budget check (Sonnet-measured; reasoning models cost more).`, {
  models: ARENA_MODELS.map((m) => ({ ...m, search: searchOf(m.id) })),
  methods: METHODS.map((m) => ({
    ...m,
    ...(m.id === "baseline" ? { mode: "baseline" } : { mode: "pipeline", filter: m.id, jevThreshold: JEV_THRESHOLD, webLeads: false }),
  })),
});

w("config/experiment.yaml", `Experiment-wide settings: spend cap, fixed helper models, arena execution.`, {
  budgetUsd: BUDGET_USD,
  smokeSpendUsd: SMOKE_SPEND_USD,
  jevModel: "typesafe-ai/jev",
  judgeModel: JUDGE_MODEL,
  arena: { concurrency: 4, defaultEvalset: "brightside_2026-11-09_2026-11-13", repeatOptions: [1, 3, 5] },
  evals: { gates: { recall: 0.9, precision: 0.8 } },
});

w("config/pipeline.yaml", `Pipeline knobs. Tiering is deterministic code driven by these numbers.`, {

  webLeads: { maxSteps: 4, numResults: 8, highlightChars: 300 },
  baseline: { searchMaxSteps: 12, anthropicMaxUses: 8, exaNumResults: 8 },
});
console.log("ok");
EOF

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import YAML from "yaml";
import { z } from "zod";
import type { CompanyProfile, FrDoc, LabelSet } from "./types";

/**
 * Everything tunable lives in poc/config/ (YAML for what people edit, JSON for data). This module only
 * reads and validates it; the rest of the code executes it. Files are re-read when they change on disk
 * (mtime check), so editing a YAML takes effect without a restart.
 */
export const CONFIG_DIR = process.env.POC_CONFIG_DIR ?? path.resolve(process.cwd(), "config");

const ISO = z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "date must be a quoted YYYY-MM-DD string");
const owner = z.object({ name: z.string(), email: z.string() });

export const CompanySchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  summary: z.string(),
  businessLines: z.array(z.string()),
  applies: z.array(z.string()),
  doesNotApply: z.array(z.string()),
  areas: z.record(z.string(), z.object({ description: z.string(), owner })),
  generalCounsel: owner,
});

const SearchKind = z.enum(["anthropic-native", "openai-native", "google-native", "exa"]);
const SetupsSchema = z.object({
  models: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), label: z.string(), vendor: z.string(), search: SearchKind })).min(1),
  methods: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        id: z.enum(["jev+llm", "llm", "baseline"]),
        label: z.string(),
        estUsd: z.number().positive(),
        mode: z.enum(["pipeline", "baseline"]),
        filter: z.enum(["jev+llm", "llm", "jev"]).optional(),
        jevThreshold: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
        webLeads: z.boolean().optional(),
      }),
    )
    .min(1),
});

const ExperimentSchema = z.object({
  budgetUsd: z.number().positive(),
  smokeSpendUsd: z.number().min(0),
  jevModel: z.string(),
  judgeModel: z.string(),
  arena: z.object({ concurrency: z.number().int().positive(), defaultEvalset: z.string(), repeatOptions: z.array(z.number().int().positive()) }),
  evals: z.object({ gates: z.object({ recall: z.number(), precision: z.number() }) }),
});

const PipelineSchema = z.object({
  tiering: z.object({ criticalWindowDays: z.number().int().positive(), recentlyEffectiveDays: z.number().int().min(0) }),
  filter: z.object({ jevConcurrency: z.number().int().positive(), llmBatchSize: z.number().int().positive(), llmConcurrency: z.number().int().positive(), abstractChars: z.number().int().positive() }),
  verify: z.object({ concurrency: z.number().int().positive(), snippetChars: z.number().int().positive() }),
  webLeads: z.object({ maxSteps: z.number().int().positive(), numResults: z.number().int().positive(), highlightChars: z.number().int().positive() }),
  baseline: z.object({ searchMaxSteps: z.number().int().positive(), anthropicMaxUses: z.number().int().positive(), exaNumResults: z.number().int().positive() }),
});

const PROMPT_NAMES = [
  "profileBrief", "jevQuestion", "jevState", "filterSystem", "filterPrompt", "extractSystem", "extractPrompt",
  "actionsSystem", "actionsPrompt", "webLeadsSystem", "webLeadsPrompt", "baselineTask", "baselineFormat", "judgeClarity",
] as const;
export type PromptName = (typeof PROMPT_NAMES)[number];
const PromptsSchema = z.object(Object.fromEntries(PROMPT_NAMES.map((n) => [n, z.string().min(1)])) as Record<PromptName, z.ZodString>);

const ManifestSchema = z.object({
  weeks: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), windowStart: ISO, windowEnd: ISO, asOf: ISO, note: z.string().optional() })),
  evalsets: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), company: z.string(), week: z.string() })),
});

export type Company = z.infer<typeof CompanySchema>;
export type Setups = z.infer<typeof SetupsSchema>;
export type Experiment = z.infer<typeof ExperimentSchema>;
export type PipelineCfg = z.infer<typeof PipelineSchema>;
export type Manifest = z.infer<typeof ManifestSchema>;

// ── file reading with mtime-based cache (edits show up immediately, unchanged files aren't re-parsed) ──
const cache = new Map<string, { mtimeMs: number; value: unknown }>();
function readFile<T>(rel: string, parse: (text: string) => T): T {
  const p = path.join(CONFIG_DIR, rel);
  const { mtimeMs } = fs.statSync(p);
  const hit = cache.get(p);
  if (hit && hit.mtimeMs === mtimeMs) return hit.value as T;
  let value: T;
  try {
    value = parse(fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8"));
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error(`config/${rel}: ${(e as Error).message}`);
  }
  cache.set(p, { mtimeMs, value });
  return value;
}
const yamlFile = <S extends z.ZodType>(rel: string, schema: S): z.infer<S> => readFile(rel, (t) => schema.parse(YAML.parse(t)));

export const experiment = () => yamlFile("experiment.yaml", ExperimentSchema);
export const setups = () => yamlFile("setups.yaml", SetupsSchema);
export const pipelineCfg = () => yamlFile("pipeline.yaml", PipelineSchema);
export const prompts = () => yamlFile("prompts.yaml", PromptsSchema);
export const manifest = () => yamlFile("evalsets/manifest.yaml", ManifestSchema);

export function companies(): CompanyProfile[] {
  const files = fs.readdirSync(path.join(CONFIG_DIR, "companies")).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".yaml")).sort();
  return files.map((f) => {
    const c = yamlFile(`companies/${f}`, CompanySchema);
    if (`${c.id}.yaml` !== f) throw new Error(`config/companies/${f}: id "${c.id}" must match the file name`);
    return c;
  });
}

export function getCompany(id: string): CompanyProfile {
  const c = companies().find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!c) throw new Error(`Unknown company "${id}" (config/companies/)`);
  return c;
}

// ── prompts ──
/** Fills {{name}} placeholders. Missing or unused variables are errors, so a template and its caller can't drift. */
export function render(template: string, vars: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  const used = new Set<string>();
  const out = template.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, k: string) => {
    if (!(k in vars)) throw new Error(`prompt placeholder {{${k}}} has no value`);
    used.add(k);
    return String(vars[k]);
  });
  const unused = Object.keys(vars).filter((k) => !used.has(k));
  if (unused.length) throw new Error(`prompt variables not used by the template: ${unused.join(", ")}`);
  return out;
}
export const prompt = (name: PromptName, vars: Record<string, string | number> = {}) => render(prompts()[name], vars);

// ── eval sets ──
const weekFile = (start: string, end: string) => `evalsets/weeks/${start}_${end}.json`;
const keyFile = (company: string, start: string, end: string) => `evalsets/keys/${company}_${start}_${end}.json`;

/** Frozen week input, or null if this window isn't an eval-set week. */
export function frozenWeek(start: string, end: string): FrDoc[] | null {
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(CONFIG_DIR, weekFile(start, end)))) return null;
  return readFile(weekFile(start, end), (t) => JSON.parse(t) as FrDoc[]);
}

export function loadKey(company: string, start: string, end: string): LabelSet | null {
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(CONFIG_DIR, keyFile(company, start, end)))) return null;
  return readFile(keyFile(company, start, end), (t) => JSON.parse(t) as LabelSet);
}

export function keyPath(company: string, start: string, end: string) {
  return path.join(CONFIG_DIR, keyFile(company, start, end));
}

export function evalsets() {
  const m = manifest();
  return m.evalsets.map((e) => {
    const week = m.weeks.find((w) => w.id === e.week);
    if (!week) throw new Error(`config/evalsets/manifest.yaml: eval set ${e.id} names unknown week ${e.week}`);
    return { ...e, ...week, id: e.id, weekId: week.id };
  });
}

/** Cross-file checks the per-file schemas can't do. Returns a list of problems (empty = valid). */
export function validateAll(): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const cos = companies();
  setups();
  experiment();
  pipelineCfg();
  prompts();
  const m = manifest();
  for (const c of cos) {
    if (!Object.keys(c.areas).length) problems.push(`company ${c.id} has no areas`);
  }
  if (!evalsets().some((e) => e.id === experiment().arena.defaultEvalset)) problems.push(`experiment.arena.defaultEvalset "${experiment().arena.defaultEvalset}" is not in the manifest`);
  for (const e of m.evalsets) {
    if (!cos.some((c) => c.id === e.company)) problems.push(`eval set ${e.id}: unknown company ${e.company}`);
    const w = m.weeks.find((x) => x.id === e.week);
    if (!w) {
      problems.push(`eval set ${e.id}: unknown week ${e.week}`);
      continue;
    }
    const input = frozenWeek(w.windowStart, w.windowEnd);
    if (!input) problems.push(`week ${w.id}: missing ${weekFile(w.windowStart, w.windowEnd)}`);
    const key = loadKey(e.company, w.windowStart, w.windowEnd);
    if (key && input) {
      const nums = new Set(input.map((d) => d.document_number));
      const stray = key.relevant.filter((n) => !nums.has(n));
      if (stray.length) problems.push(`key ${e.id}: doc numbers not in the week input: ${stray.join(", ")}`);
      const noDetail = key.details ? key.relevant.filter((n) => !key.details![n]) : [];
      if (noDetail.length) problems.push(`key ${e.id}: relevant docs without details: ${noDetail.join(", ")}`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

/** Short hash of every config file except the (large, frozen) week inputs — stamped on each run. */
export function configHash(): string {
  const h = crypto.createHash("sha256");
  const walk = (dir: string) => {
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
      const p = path.join(dir, f.name);
      if (f.isDirectory()) {
        if (p !== path.join(CONFIG_DIR, "evalsets")) walk(p);
      } else if (/\.(ya?ml)$/.test(f.name)) {
        h.update(path.relative(CONFIG_DIR, p));
        h.update(fs.readFileSync(p));
      }
    }
  };
  walk(CONFIG_DIR);
  return h.digest("hex").slice(0, 10);
}

import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { frozenWeek, getCompany, render, validateAll } from "../src/lib/config";
import { actionsPrompt, baselineTask, filterPrompt } from "../src/lib/prompts";
import { assignTier } from "../src/lib/tier";
import type { ActionItem, RunConfig } from "../src/lib/types";

// Prompts the arena actually sent on 2026-11-21 (copied from data/runs transcripts). If a config edit changes
// what the models see, these fail — on purpose: old and new runs would no longer be comparable.
const recorded = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "fixtures/recorded-prompts.json"), "utf8"));

describe("config/", () => {
  it("every file parses and cross-references resolve", () => {
    expect(validateAll()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("render fails loudly on a missing or an unused variable", () => {
    expect(render("a {{x}}", { x: 1 })).toBe("a 1");
    expect(() => render("a {{x}}", {})).toThrow(/\{\{x\}\} has no value/);
    expect(() => render("a", { x: 1 })).toThrow(/not used/);
  });
});

describe("prompts rebuilt from config/prompts.yaml match what the arena sent", () => {
  it("baseline task", () => {
    const cfg = recorded.baselineTask.config as RunConfig;
    expect(baselineTask(getCompany(cfg.profileId), cfg)).toBe(recorded.baselineTask.prompt);
  });

  it("LLM filter, first batch of the LLM-only run (from the frozen week input)", () => {
    const docs = frozenWeek("2026-11-09", "2026-11-13")!.slice(0, 20);
    expect(filterPrompt(getCompany("brightside"), docs)).toBe(recorded.filterPrompt0.prompt);
  });

  it("action writing", () => {
    expect(actionsPrompt(getCompany("brightside"), recorded.actionsPrompt.items as ActionItem[])).toBe(recorded.actionsPrompt.prompt);
  });
});

describe("tier rules are passed in, not read from an editable file", () => {
  it("the window comes from the argument", () => {
    const deadlines = [{ date: "2026-12-13", kind: "comment" as const, source: "fr_field" as const, verified: true }];
    expect(assignTier({ type: "Proposed Rule", deadlines, asOf: "2026-11-13", rules: { criticalWindowDays: 90, recentlyEffectiveDays: 30 } }).tier).toBe("Critical");
    expect(assignTier({ type: "Proposed Rule", deadlines, asOf: "2026-11-13", rules: { criticalWindowDays: 20, recentlyEffectiveDays: 30 } }).tier).toBe("Medium");
  });
});

describe("frozen answer keys", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
    vi.resetModules();
  });

  it("saveLabels refuses to overwrite a key with provenance, but writes a draft key", async () => {
    const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cfg-"));
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, "evalsets/keys"), { recursive: true });
    const base = { profileId: "acme", windowStart: "2026-01-05", windowEnd: "2026-01-09", relevant: ["X"], reviewedAgencies: [], notes: {}, updatedAt: "" };
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "evalsets/keys/acme_2026-01-05_2026-01-09.json"), JSON.stringify({ ...base, provenance: "frozen" }));
    vi.stubEnv("POC_CONFIG_DIR", dir);
    vi.resetModules();
    const { saveLabels, loadLabels } = await import("../src/lib/store");

    await saveLabels({ ...base, profileId: "draft" });
    expect((await loadLabels("draft", "2026-01-05", "2026-01-09"))?.relevant).toEqual(["X"]);

import { pipelineCfg, prompt } from "./config";
import { agencyNames } from "./fr";
import type { ActionItem, CompanyProfile, FrDoc } from "./types";

// Prompt text lives in config/prompts.yaml. These functions only render data into its placeholders.

const bullets = (xs: string[]) => xs.map((x) => `- ${x}`).join("\n");

export const profileBrief = (p: CompanyProfile) =>
  prompt("profileBrief", { name: p.name, summary: p.summary, applies: bullets(p.applies), doesNotApply: bullets(p.doesNotApply) });

/** How one Federal Register document is shown to a model (data formatting, not prompt wording). */
export const docBlock = (d: FrDoc) =>
  [`[${d.document_number}] ${d.type} — ${agencyNames(d).join("; ")}`, `Title: ${d.title}`, d.action ? `Action: ${d.action}` : "", `Abstract: ${(d.abstract ?? "(none)").slice(0, pipelineCfg().filter.abstractChars)}`]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n");

export const jevQuestion = () => prompt("jevQuestion");
export const jevState = (p: CompanyProfile, d: FrDoc) => prompt("jevState", { profile: profileBrief(p), document: docBlock(d) });

export const filterSystem = (p: CompanyProfile) => prompt("filterSystem", { areas: bullets(Object.entries(p.areas).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v.description}`)) });
export const filterPrompt = (p: CompanyProfile, docs: FrDoc[]) =>
  prompt("filterPrompt", { profile: profileBrief(p), count: docs.length, documents: docs.map(docBlock).join("\n\n") });

export const extractSystem = () => prompt("extractSystem");
export const extractPrompt = (d: FrDoc, text: string) => prompt("extractPrompt", { number: d.document_number, title: d.title, text });

export const actionsSystem = () => prompt("actionsSystem");
export const actionsPrompt = (p: CompanyProfile, items: Pick<ActionItem, "document_number" | "type" | "title" | "tier" | "tierReason" | "owner" | "reason">[]) =>
  prompt("actionsPrompt", {
    profile: profileBrief(p),
    items: items.map((i) => `[${i.document_number}] ${i.type}: ${i.title}\nTier: ${i.tier} (${i.tierReason})\nOwner: ${i.owner.name}\nWhy relevant: ${i.reason}`).join("\n\n"),
  });

export const webLeadsSystem = () => prompt("webLeadsSystem");
export const webLeadsPrompt = (p: CompanyProfile, windowStart: string, windowEnd: string) => prompt("webLeadsPrompt", { profile: profileBrief(p), windowStart, windowEnd });

export const baselineTask = (p: CompanyProfile, cfg: { windowStart: string; windowEnd: string; asOf: string }) =>
  prompt("baselineTask", {
    profile: profileBrief(p),
    areasWithOwners: bullets(Object.entries(p.areas).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v.description} → ${v.owner.name}`)),
    windowStart: cfg.windowStart,
    windowEnd: cfg.windowEnd,
    asOf: cfg.asOf,
    criticalWindowDays: pipelineCfg().tiering.criticalWindowDays,
  });
export const baselineFormat = (task: string, research: string) => prompt("baselineFormat", { task, research });

export const judgeClarity = (items: unknown[]) => prompt("judgeClarity", { items: JSON.stringify(items, null, 1) });

async function getJson(url: string) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { accept: "application/json" } });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Federal Register ${res.status} for ${url}`);
  return res.json();
}

/** Every document published in [start, end]. The scan is exhaustive on purpose: recall is measured against the whole week. */
export async function listWindow(start: string, end: string, useCache = true): Promise<FrDoc[]> {
  return cached(`window-${start}-${end}.json`, async () => {
    const out: FrDoc[] = [];
    for (let page = 1; page < 50; page++) {
      const params: [string, string][] = [
        ["per_page", "1000"],
        ["page", String(page)],
        ["order", "oldest"],
        ["conditions[publication_date][gte]", start],
        ["conditions[publication_date][lte]", end],
        ...FIELDS.map((f) => ["fields[]", f] as [string, string]),
      ];
      const data = await getJson(`${API}/documents.json?${qs(params)}`);
      out.push(...(data.results ?? []));
      if (!data.total_pages || page >= data.total_pages) break;
    }
    return out;
  }, useCache);
}

import { judgeClarity } from "./judge";
import { ARENA_MODELS, modelLabel } from "./models";
import { execute, newRun } from "./pipeline/run";
import { BUDGET_USD, listRuns, saveRun, spentUsd } from "./store";
import type { RunConfig, RunRecord } from "./types";

/** An arena cell = one config. The facade is RunConfig; cells just name a point in the model × method grid. */
export interface Cell {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  model: string;
  method: "jev+llm" | "llm" | "baseline";
  /** Rough $/run used for the pre-flight budget check (measured on Sonnet 5.5; reasoning models may differ). */
  estUsd: number;
}

export const METHODS: { id: Cell["method"]; label: string; estUsd: number }[] = [
  { id: "jev+llm", label: "Pipeline · Jev filter → LLM", estUsd: 0.2 },
  { id: "llm", label: "Pipeline · LLM filter only", estUsd: 0.4 },
  { id: "baseline", label: "Baseline · 1 prompt + web search", estUsd: 0.6 },
];

export const ALL_CELLS: Cell[] = METHODS.flatMap((m) =>
  ARENA_MODELS.map((x) => ({ key: `${m.id}:${x.id}`, label: `${modelLabel(x.id)} · ${m.label}`, model: x.id, method: m.id, estUsd: m.estUsd })),
);

export const cellByKey = (k: string) => ALL_CELLS.find((c) => c.key === k);

export const JEV_THRESHOLD = 0.1;
const CONCURRENCY = 4;

export function cellConfig(cell: Cell, base: { profileId: string; windowStart: string; windowEnd: string; asOf: string }, arena: string): RunConfig {
  return {
    ...base,
    mode: cell.method === "baseline" ? "baseline" : "pipeline",
    model: cell.model,
    filter: cell.method === "llm" ? "llm" : "jev+llm",
    jevThreshold: JEV_THRESHOLD,
    webLeads: false, // measured redundant for federal scope in the pilot (24 URLs → 0 new docs)
    group: `${arena}:${cell.key}`,
    arena,
    cell: cell.key,
  };
}

export function estimate(cells: Cell[], repeat: number) {
  return cells.reduce((a, c) => a + c.estUsd, 0) * repeat;
}

import { anthropic } from "@ai-sdk/anthropic";
import { google } from "@ai-sdk/google";
import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai";
import type { ToolSet } from "ai";
import { pipelineCfg, setups } from "./config";
import { gw } from "./gateway";

// Contestants and their baseline search live in config/setups.yaml.

export const arenaModels = () => setups().models;

const HELPER_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { "anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5": "Haiku 5.5" };
export const modelLabel = (id: string) => arenaModels().find((m) => m.id === id)?.label ?? HELPER_LABELS[id] ?? id;

const searchOf = (model: string) => arenaModels().find((m) => m.id === model)?.search ?? "exa";

/** Web search for the baseline, as configured per model (vendor-native, or the Gateway's Exa). */
export function searchTools(model: string): ToolSet {
  const b = pipelineCfg().baseline;
  switch (searchOf(model)) {
    case "anthropic-native":
      return { web_search: anthropic.tools.webSearch_20250305({ maxUses: b.anthropicMaxUses }) };
    case "openai-native":
      return { web_search: openai.tools.webSearch({}) };
    case "google-native":
      return { google_search: google.tools.googleSearch({}) };
    case "exa":
      return { web_search: gw.tools.exaSearch({ numResults: b.exaNumResults }) };
  }
}

export const searchKind = (model: string) => (searchOf(model) === "exa" ? "Exa search" : "native search");

import { experiment, setups } from "./config";
import { judgeClarity } from "./judge";
import { modelLabel } from "./models";
import { execute, newRun } from "./pipeline/run";
import { budgetUsd, listRuns, saveRun, spentUsd } from "./store";
import type { RunConfig, RunRecord } from "./types";

/** An arena cell = one (model, method) pair from config/setups.yaml. Its RunConfig is what the code executes. */
export interface Cell {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  model: string;
  method: "jev+llm" | "llm" | "baseline";
  /** Rough $/run used for the pre-flight budget check. */
  estUsd: number;
}

export const methods = () => setups().methods;

export const allCells = (): Cell[] =>
  methods().flatMap((m) =>
    setups().models.map((x) => ({ key: `${m.id}:${x.id}`, label: `${modelLabel(x.id)} · ${m.label}`, model: x.id, method: m.id, estUsd: m.estUsd })),
  );

export const cellByKey = (k: string) => allCells().find((c) => c.key === k);

export function cellConfig(cell: Cell, base: { profileId: string; windowStart: string; windowEnd: string; asOf: string }, arena: string): RunConfig {
  const m = methods().find((x) => x.id === cell.method)!;
  // Baseline runs don't filter, but RunConfig carries filter fields; they inherit the Jev method's values.
  const jev = methods().find((x) => x.id === "jev+llm");
  return {
    ...base,
    mode: m.mode,
    model: cell.model,
    filter: m.filter ?? jev?.filter ?? "jev+llm",
    jevThreshold: m.jevThreshold ?? jev?.jevThreshold ?? 0.1,
    webLeads: m.webLeads ?? false,
    group: `${arena}:${cell.key}`,
    arena,
    cell: cell.key,
  };
}

export function estimate(cells: Cell[], repeat: number) {
  return cells.reduce((a, c) => a + c.estUsd, 0) * repeat;
}

/**
 * Creates every run up front (so the page shows all cells immediately), then executes in waves of
 * `experiment.arena.concurrency`. Each run snapshots spend at start and can't see siblings, so the budget is
 * re-checked between waves using the worst-case estimate of the next wave.
 */
export async function startArena(args: { profileId: string; windowStart: string; windowEnd: string; asOf: string; cellKeys: string[]; repeat: number }) {
  const cells = args.cellKeys.map(cellByKey).filter((c): c is Cell => !!c);
  const est = estimate(cells, args.repeat);
  const spent = await spentUsd();
  const budget = budgetUsd();
  if (spent + est > budget) throw new Error(`Estimated $${est.toFixed(2)} would exceed the budget ($${spent.toFixed(2)} of $${budget} spent)`);

  const arena = `arena-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace(/[:T]/g, "-")}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)}`;
  const runs: { run: RunRecord; cell: Cell }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < args.repeat; i++) for (const cell of cells) runs.push({ run: newRun(cellConfig(cell, args, arena)), cell });
  await Promise.all(runs.map((r) => saveRun(r.run)));

  const concurrency = experiment().arena.concurrency;
  const go = async () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i += concurrency) {
      const wave = runs.slice(i, i + concurrency);
      const waveEst = wave.reduce((a, w) => a + w.cell.estUsd, 0);
      if ((await spentUsd()) + waveEst > budgetUsd()) {
        for (const w of runs.slice(i)) {
          w.run.status = "error";
          w.run.error = "Skipped: budget cap would be exceeded";
          await saveRun(w.run);
        }
        return;
      }
      await Promise.all(
        wave.map(async (w) => {
          await execute(w.run);
          if (w.run.status === "done") {
            w.run.judge = await judgeClarity(w.run);
            await saveRun(w.run);
          }
        }),
      );
    }
  };
  return { arena, runIds: runs.map((r) => r.run.id), estimateUsd: est, go };
}

export async function arenaRuns(arena: string) {
  return (await listRuns()).filter((r) => r.config.arena === arena);
}

export async function listArenas() {
  const runs = (await listRuns()).filter((r) => r.config.arena);
  const by = new Map<string, RunRecord[]>();
  for (const r of runs) by.set(r.config.arena!, [...(by.get(r.config.arena!) ?? []), r]);
  return [...by.entries()]
    .map(([id, rs]) => ({
      id,
      createdAt: rs.map((r) => r.createdAt).sort()[0],
      profileId: rs[0].config.profileId,
      windowStart: rs[0].config.windowStart,
      windowEnd: rs[0].config.windowEnd,
      runs: rs.length,
      running: rs.filter((r) => r.status === "running").length,
      costUsd: rs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.totalCostUsd + (r.judge?.costUsd ?? 0), 0),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt));
}

import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { experiment, keyPath, loadKey } from "./config";
import type { LabelSet, RunRecord } from "./types";

// Outputs (runs) live in data/; inputs, keys and settings live in config/.
const RUNS = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "data", "runs");

/** Hard cap for the whole experiment (config/experiment.yaml → budgetUsd). Runs refuse to start past it. */
export const budgetUsd = () => experiment().budgetUsd;

export async function saveRun(run: RunRecord) {
  await fs.mkdir(RUNS, { recursive: true });
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(RUNS, `${run.id}.json`), JSON.stringify(run, null, 2));
}

export async function loadRun(id: string): Promise<RunRecord | null> {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(RUNS, `${id}.json`), "utf8"));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function listRuns(): Promise<RunRecord[]> {
  await fs.mkdir(RUNS, { recursive: true });
  const files = (await fs.readdir(RUNS)).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"));
  const runs = await Promise.all(files.map((f) => fs.readFile(path.join(RUNS, f), "utf8").then((s) => JSON.parse(s) as RunRecord)));
  return runs.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt));
}

/** Answer key for a company-week (config/evalsets/keys/), or null. */
export async function loadLabels(profileId: string, start: string, end: string): Promise<LabelSet | null> {
  return loadKey(profileId, start, end);
}

export async function saveLabels(l: LabelSet) {
  // A key with provenance is frozen: every arena is graded against the same file.
  const existing = loadKey(l.profileId, l.windowStart, l.windowEnd);
  if (existing?.provenance) throw new Error(`Answer key is frozen (${existing.provenance}); edit the file deliberately if it must change`);
  const p = keyPath(l.profileId, l.windowStart, l.windowEnd);
  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
  await fs.writeFile(p, JSON.stringify({ ...l, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, null, 2));
}

/** Spend = sum of every persisted run's cost (no shared counter → no write races) + out-of-run smoke-test spend. */
export async function spentUsd(): Promise<number> {
  const runs = await listRuns();
  return runs.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.totalCostUsd ?? 0) + (r.judge?.costUsd ?? 0), 0) + experiment().smokeSpendUsd;
}

import { generateText, Output } from "ai";
import { z } from "zod";
import { experiment } from "./config";
import { gw, gatewayCost } from "./gateway";
import { judgeClarity as judgePrompt } from "./prompts";
import type { RunRecord } from "./types";

/** The only model-graded metric: is each action item clear and usable? Relevance and dates are graded by code. */
export async function judgeClarity(run: RunRecord): Promise<NonNullable<RunRecord["judge"]>> {
  const model = experiment().judgeModel;
  const items = (run.items ?? []).map((i) => ({ document_number: i.document_number, title: i.title, owner: i.owner.name, reason: i.reason, action: i.action }));
  if (!items.length) return { model, clarity: null, perItem: [], costUsd: 0 };
  try {
    const r = await generateText({
      model: gw(model),
      output: Output.object({ schema: z.object({ scores: z.array(z.object({ document_number: z.string(), score: z.number().min(0).max(1), why: z.string() })) }) }),
      prompt: judgePrompt(items),
    });
    const scores = r.output.scores;
    return {
      model,
      clarity: scores.length ? scores.reduce((a, s) => a + s.score, 0) / scores.length : null,
      perItem: scores,
      costUsd: gatewayCost(r.providerMetadata),
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { model, clarity: null, perItem: [], costUsd: 0, error: (e as Error).message };
  }
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { connection } from "next/server";
import ArenaForm from "@/components/ArenaForm";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { listArenas, methods } from "@/lib/arena";
import { companies, evalsets, experiment, frozenWeek, getCompany, loadKey } from "@/lib/config";
import { arenaModels } from "@/lib/models";
import { budgetUsd, spentUsd } from "@/lib/store";

export default async function Home() {
  await connection();
  const [arenas, spent] = await Promise.all([listArenas(), spentUsd()]);
  const sets = evalsets().map((e) => {
    const c = getCompany(e.company);
    return {
      id: e.id,
      label: `${c.name} · ${e.windowStart} → ${e.windowEnd}`,
      companyId: c.id,
      summary: c.summary,
      windowStart: e.windowStart,
      windowEnd: e.windowEnd,
      docs: frozenWeek(e.windowStart, e.windowEnd)?.length ?? 0,
      keyed: loadKey(e.company, e.windowStart, e.windowEnd)?.relevant.length ?? null,
    };
  });
  const names = Object.fromEntries(companies().map((c) => [c.id, c.name]));
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <ArenaForm
        evalsets={sets}
        defaultEvalset={experiment().arena.defaultEvalset}
        repeatOptions={experiment().arena.repeatOptions}
        models={arenaModels().map((m) => ({ id: m.id, label: m.label, vendor: m.vendor }))}
        methods={methods().map((m) => ({ id: m.id, label: m.label, estUsd: m.estUsd }))}
        spent={spent}
        budget={budgetUsd()}
      />
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Past arenas</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {!arenas.length && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">None yet.</p>}

"use client";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";

interface EvalsetOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  companyId: string;
  summary: string;
  windowStart: string;
  windowEnd: string;
  docs: number;
  keyed: number | null;
}

interface Props {
  evalsets: EvalsetOption[];
  defaultEvalset: string;
  repeatOptions: number[];
  models: { id: string; label: string; vendor: string }[];
  methods: { id: string; label: string; estUsd: number }[];
  spent: number;
  budget: number;
}

export default function ArenaForm({ evalsets, defaultEvalset, repeatOptions, models, methods, spent, budget }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [setId, setSetId] = useState(evalsets.some((e) => e.id === defaultEvalset) ? defaultEvalset : evalsets[0]?.id);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(methods.flatMap((m) => models.map((x) => `${m.id}:${x.id}`))));
  const [repeat, setRepeat] = useState(repeatOptions[0] ?? 1);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const est = useMemo(() => methods.reduce((a, m) => a + models.filter((x) => picked.has(`${m.id}:${x.id}`)).length * m.estUsd, 0) * repeat, [picked, repeat, methods, models]);
  const left = budget - spent;
  const set = evalsets.find((e) => e.id === setId);

  const toggle = (k: string) =>
    setPicked((s) => {
      const n = new Set(s);
      if (n.has(k)) n.delete(k);
      else n.add(k);
      return n;
    });

  async function go() {
    if (!set) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(null);
    const res = await fetch("/api/arena", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ profileId: set.companyId, windowStart: set.windowStart, windowEnd: set.windowEnd, cellKeys: [...picked], repeat }) });
    const j = await res.json();
    setBusy(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setErr(j.error);
    router.push(`/arena/${j.arena}`);
  }

  if (!set) return <p className="text-sm">No eval sets in config/evalsets/manifest.yaml.</p>;

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Start an arena</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Every ticked box is one setup. They all read the same frozen week of federal rules and get graded against the same answer key. Setups, prompts and eval sets come from <code>poc/config/</code>.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-5">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">Eval set (company · week)</span>
            <select className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2" value={setId} onChange={(e) => setSetId(e.target.value)}>
              {evalsets.map((e) => (
                <option key={e.id} value={e.id}>{e.label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{set.summary}</span>
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">What it contains</span>
            <div className="h-9 rounded-md border px-2 flex items-center">{set.docs} rules published · {set.keyed === null ? "no answer key yet" : `${set.keyed} that matter (answer key)`}</div>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Frozen input, so every setup sees exactly the same documents.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="text-muted-foreground">
                <th className="text-left font-normal py-2">How it works ↓ · Model →</th>
                {models.map((m) => (
                  <th key={m.id} className="font-normal px-2 py-2">{m.label}<div className="text-xs">{m.vendor}</div></th>
                ))}
                <th className="font-normal px-2 text-right">≈ $/run</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {methods.map((me) => (
                <tr key={me.id} className="border-t">
                  <td className="py-2">{me.label}</td>
                  {models.map((m) => {
                    const k = `${me.id}:${m.id}`;
                    return (
                      <td key={k} className="text-center px-2">
                        <Checkbox checked={picked.has(k)} onCheckedChange={() => toggle(k)} aria-label={`${me.label} with ${m.label}`} className="mx-auto" />
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
                  <td className="text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">${me.estUsd.toFixed(2)}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
            Repeat each
            <select className="h-8 rounded-md border bg-background px-2" value={repeat} onChange={(e) => setRepeat(Number(e.target.value))}>
              {repeatOptions.map((n) => (
                <option key={n} value={n}>{n}×</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">(3× shows whether answers stay the same)</span>
          </label>
          <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs">
            ≈ ${est.toFixed(2)} for {picked.size * repeat} runs · ${left.toFixed(2)} of ${budget} left
          </span>
          <Button disabled={busy || !picked.size || est > left} onClick={go}>{busy ? "Starting…" : "Run arena"}</Button>
        </div>
        {err && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{err}</p>}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/**
 * Experiment 2 — what our evals look like. Everything it grades comes from poc/config/:
 * eval sets (frozen week + answer key) × setups (models × methods), gates from experiment.yaml.
 *
 * Following Anthropic's "Demystifying evals for AI agents":
 *  - grade the OUTCOME with code where possible (recall/precision on FR document numbers, dates vs the key),
 *  - grade the TRANSCRIPT as a secondary signal (did it ground on federalregister.gov?),
 *  - use an LLM judge only where code can't (is the action item clear?) — persisted on the run, not re-asked.
 *
 * EVAL_MODE=replay → grade the latest finished run per (eval set, setup) (free). Default.
 * EVAL_MODE=live   → execute fresh runs (spends money).
 */
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { createHarness, createJudge, describeEval } from "vitest-evals";
import { allCells, cellConfig, type Cell } from "../src/lib/arena";
import { evalsets, experiment, loadKey } from "../src/lib/config";
import { judgeClarity } from "../src/lib/judge";
import { execute, newRun } from "../src/lib/pipeline/run";
import { datesAgainstKey, scoreRun } from "../src/lib/score";
import { listRuns } from "../src/lib/store";
import type { LabelSet, RunRecord } from "../src/lib/types";

const LIVE = process.env.EVAL_MODE === "live";
const GATES = experiment().evals.gates;

type EvalSet = ReturnType<typeof evalsets>[number];
type CaseInput = { name: string; set: EvalSet; cell: Cell; key: LabelSet };
type CaseOutput = {
  runId: string;
  recall: number;
  precision: number;
  tp: number;
  fp: number;
  missed: string[];
  extra: string[];
  datesChecked: number;
  datesCorrect: number;
  datesShown: number;
  datesVerified: number;
  clarity: number | null;
  costUsd: number;
  seconds: number;
  groundedOnFR: boolean;
};

/** Same company, same week, same setup — never grade one company's run against another's key. */
const matches = (r: RunRecord, c: CaseInput) =>
  r.status === "done" &&
  r.config.profileId === c.set.company &&
  r.config.windowStart === c.set.windowStart &&
  r.config.windowEnd === c.set.windowEnd &&
  (r.config.cell ? r.config.cell === c.cell.key : r.config.model === c.cell.model && (c.cell.method === "baseline" ? r.config.mode === "baseline" : r.config.mode === "pipeline" && r.config.filter === c.cell.method));

async function getRun(c: CaseInput): Promise<RunRecord | null> {
  if (LIVE) {
    const r = await execute(newRun(cellConfig(c.cell, { profileId: c.set.company, windowStart: c.set.windowStart, windowEnd: c.set.windowEnd, asOf: c.set.asOf }, `eval-${Date.now().toString(36)}`)));
    if (r.status === "done") r.judge = await judgeClarity(r);
    return r;
  }
  return (await listRuns()).find((r) => matches(r, c)) ?? null;
}

const CASES: CaseInput[] = evalsets().flatMap((set) => {
  const key = loadKey(set.company, set.windowStart, set.windowEnd);
  return key ? allCells().map((cell) => ({ name: `${set.id} · ${cell.label}`, set, cell, key })) : [];
});

const harness = createHarness<CaseInput, CaseOutput>({
  name: "reg-monitor",
  run: async ({ input }) => {
    const run = await getRun(input);
    if (!run) throw new Error(`No finished run for "${input.name}" — run an arena or set EVAL_MODE=live.`);
    const s = scoreRun(run, input.key);
    const d = datesAgainstKey(run, input.key);
    // Transcript check: pipeline grounds on the FR API by construction; baseline must have searched AND every kept item resolved to FR.
    const searched = run.config.mode === "pipeline" || run.calls.some((c) => c.toolCalls?.some((t) => /search/i.test(t.name)));
    const output: CaseOutput = {
      runId: run.id,
      recall: s.recall,
      precision: s.precision,
      tp: s.tp,
      fp: s.fp,
      missed: s.missed,
      extra: s.extra,
      datesChecked: d.checked,
      datesCorrect: d.correct,
      datesShown: s.datesShown,
      datesVerified: s.datesVerified,
      clarity: run.judge?.clarity ?? null,
      costUsd: run.totalCostUsd + (run.judge?.costUsd ?? 0),
      seconds: run.totalMs / 1000,
      groundedOnFR: searched && run.stages.some((st) => st.name.startsWith("scan:federal-register") || st.name.includes("resolve")),
    };
    return {
      events: [
        { type: "message", role: "user", content: `${input.name} (${run.id})` },
        ...run.calls.flatMap((c, k) => (c.toolCalls ?? []).map((t, j) => ({ type: "tool_call" as const, id: `${k}-${j}`, name: t.name, arguments: (t.input ?? {}) as Record<string, never> }))),
        { type: "message", role: "assistant", content: run.markdown ?? "" },
      ],
      output,
      usage: {},
    };
  },
});

// ── Code graders ──
const RecallJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>(`Recall ≥ ${GATES.recall}`, ({ output }) => ({ score: output.recall, metadata: { rationale: `found ${output.tp}; missed ${output.missed.join(", ") || "none"}` } }));
const PrecisionJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>(`Precision ≥ ${GATES.precision}`, ({ output }) => ({ score: output.precision, metadata: { rationale: `extra ${output.extra.join(", ") || "none"}` } }));
const DatesJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Dates match the key", ({ output }) => ({
  score: output.datesChecked ? output.datesCorrect / output.datesChecked : 1,
  metadata: { rationale: `${output.datesCorrect}/${output.datesChecked} found rules show the key's deadline` },
}));
// ── Model grader, persisted on the run when it finished ──
const ClarityJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>(`Clarity (${experiment().judgeModel})`, ({ output }) => ({ score: output.clarity ?? 0, metadata: { rationale: output.clarity === null ? "no judge score on run" : "" } }));

describeEval(
  "regulatory triage · config/evalsets × config/setups",
  { harness, judges: [RecallJudge, PrecisionJudge, DatesJudge, ClarityJudge], judgeThreshold: null },
  (it) => {
    it.for(CASES)("$name", async (c, { run }) => {
      const o = (await run(c)).output;
      console.log(`${c.name}: recall ${o.recall.toFixed(2)} precision ${o.precision.toFixed(2)} dates ${o.datesCorrect}/${o.datesChecked} $${o.costUsd.toFixed(3)} ${o.seconds.toFixed(0)}s`);
      // Hard gates from the RFC (config/experiment.yaml). Expected to fail for some setups — that's the comparison.
      expect.soft(o.recall, "recall").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(GATES.recall);
      expect.soft(o.precision, "precision").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(GATES.precision);
      expect.soft(o.datesCorrect, "every found rule shows the key's deadline").toBe(o.datesChecked);
      expect.soft(o.datesVerified, "every shown date verified against the source").toBe(o.datesShown);
      expect.soft(o.groundedOnFR, "grounded on federalregister.gov").toBe(true);
    });
  },
);

# config/ — everything the experiment runs on

The code only executes what's in here. Edit a file and the next run picks it up; no code change and no restart.
Every file is validated on load (`pnpm test` runs the cross-file checks too).

```
config/
├── experiment.yaml      budget cap, Jev + judge models, arena concurrency, default eval set, RFC gates
├── setups.yaml          arena contestants: models (+ which web search their baseline gets) × methods
├── pipeline.yaml        knobs: tier rules (90 / 30 days), batch sizes, concurrency, text limits
├── prompts.yaml         every prompt sent to a model, with {{placeholders}}
├── companies/           one company profile per file (relevance anchor + area → owner routing)
│   ├── brightside.yaml
│   └── ledgerly.yaml
└── evalsets/
    ├── manifest.yaml    which (company, week) pairs are eval sets
    ├── weeks/           frozen Federal Register input, one JSON per week
    └── keys/            answer keys, one JSON per company-week (frozen ones have `provenance`)
```

## How to…

| I want to… | Edit |
|---|---|
| add a contestant model | `setups.yaml → models` (pick `search`: anthropic-native / openai-native / google-native / exa) |
| change the Jev cut-off | `setups.yaml → methods[jev+llm].jevThreshold` |
| change what "Critical" means | `pipeline.yaml → tiering` |
| tweak a prompt | `prompts.yaml` (the prompt tests will fail on purpose, since old runs were made with the old text) |
| add a company | new `companies/<id>.yaml` (file name = `id`) |
| add an eval set | add the week to `manifest.yaml → weeks` + its JSON in `weeks/`, a key in `keys/`, and an entry in `manifest.yaml → evalsets` |
| raise the budget | `experiment.yaml → budgetUsd` |

## What stays in code, and why

Zod output schemas, tool construction (search clients), the date-stripping regex and the date-quote verifier.
They're logic, not settings. Run outputs stay in `data/runs/` (results, not config). Each run records a
`configHash` of the YAML files it ran under, so runs made with different prompts or knobs aren't compared by accident.

// Re-records tests/fixtures/recorded-prompts.json from a finished arena's transcripts.
// Run after you deliberately change a prompt/company/knob AND have re-run an arena with it:
//   npx tsx scripts/record-prompt-fixtures.mts <arenaId>
// The prompt tests then pin the new wording, so a later accidental edit is caught.
import fs from "node:fs";
import { arenaRuns } from "../src/lib/arena";

const runs = (await arenaRuns(process.argv[2])).filter((r) => r.status === "done");
const pick = (cell: string) => {
  const r = runs.find((x) => x.config.cell === cell);
  if (!r) throw new Error(`arena has no finished run for ${cell}`);
  return r;
};
const call = (r: (typeof runs)[number], stage: string) => {
  const c = r.calls.find((x) => x.stage === stage);
  if (!c?.prompt) throw new Error(`${r.id} has no logged prompt for ${stage}`);
  return c.prompt;
};
const base = pick("baseline:anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5");
const llm = pick("llm:anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5");
const actions = call(llm, "output-actions");
const items = (llm.items ?? [])
  .map(({ document_number, type, title, tier, tierReason, owner, reason }) => ({ document_number, type, title, tier, tierReason, owner, reason }))
  .sort((a, b) => actions.indexOf(`[${a.document_number}]`) - actions.indexOf(`[${b.document_number}]`));
const fx = {
  baselineTask: { config: base.config, prompt: call(base, "baseline:search"), run: base.id },
  filterPrompt0: { profileId: llm.config.profileId, prompt: call(llm, "filter-llm#0"), run: llm.id },
  actionsPrompt: { profileId: llm.config.profileId, items, prompt: actions, run: llm.id },
  arenaConfigs: runs.map((r) => r.config),
};
fs.writeFileSync("tests/fixtures/recorded-prompts.json", JSON.stringify(fx, null, 1));
console.log(`recorded from ${runs.length} runs of ${process.argv[2]}`);
EOF
